fact: Healthcare managers interviewed in ||Kharas region and at national level state that DHIS2 is used at district, regional and national levels while primary health facilities still report on paper, district HIS officers keying the facilities' paper monthly summary forms into DHIS2; donors fund its customisation and equipment, and the HIS strategy is still a draft.
title: Managers' perspectives on using routine health information systems for effective child healthcare programmes in Namibia
publisher: South African Journal of Information Management
